final: WITH g AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId AS rep_id, e.City AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), ca AS (SELECT city, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g GROUP BY city), j AS (SELECT g.rep_id, g.city, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / ca.avg_cnt AS city_ratio FROM g JOIN ca ON g.city = ca.city), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM j) SELECT j.rep_id, j.city, j.cnt, j.city_ratio, j.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS overall_ratio FROM j CROSS JOIN t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY overall_ratio IS NULL, overall_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
